name: vscode
description: Behavior-preserving refactorings that refuse when they cannot prove a change is safe.

keybindings.when: config.riktigrefactor.rename.overrideF2 && editorTextFocus && !editorReadonly && (editorLangId == csharp || editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == c)

editorContext.when: editorLangId == csharp || editorLangId == cpp || editorLangId == c

riktigrefactor.csharp.command.description: The riktig-cs tool (install with: dotnet tool install --global RiktigRefactor.CSharp.Tool).

riktigrefactor.csharp.workspace.description: The .sln, .slnx or .csproj to load, relative to the workspace folder. Empty means find one in the workspace folder.

riktigrefactor.cpp.workspace.description: The compile_commands.json to load, relative to the workspace folder. Empty means look in the workspace folder and its build folder.

riktigrefactor.rename.overrideF2.description: Use Riktig Rename instead of the built-in rename on F2 in C# and C++ files.

riktigrefactor.previewBeforeApplying.description: Show VS Code's refactor preview, with warnings, before applying a refactoring.
